---
description: "Use when creating or modifying C# LINQ expressions. Requires fluent method-chain syntax."
applyTo: "**/*.cs"
---

# C# LINQ Style

- Write LINQ expressions with fluent method-chain syntax, such as `.Where(...).Select(...)`.
- Never use C# query-expression syntax (`from`, `join`, `let`, `where`, `orderby`, `group`, `select`).
